baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction in which the Lord's word becomes due upon those who cover.
baseline_models.mechanism: A meaningful divine utterance, backed by lordly sovereignty, passes from statement into binding obligation against active concealment of truth.

activation_trace.role: Fixed obligation supplies the transition from a spoken warning to a liability that now adheres.
A meaningful verbal unit supplies the articulated content that can take effect.
Sovereign ownership supplies the authority under which the utterance binds.
Concealment and rejection of truth identify the conduct against which the liability settles.

changed_reading.before: A divine statement predicts that disbelievers will be punished.
changed_reading.after: The Lord's articulated ruling has crossed into binding validity against those who actively cover truth.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The predication that they are companions of the fire.
baseline_models.mechanism: Companionship makes fire an enduring co-presence rather than a merely external penalty, while the fire's luminosity opposes the covering operation named in the condemned group.

activation_trace.role: Sustained accompaniment turns destination into a durable relation.
Kindled fire supplies the concrete companion and punitive medium.
Illumination supplies a secondary revealing function within that punitive medium.
Material covering supplies what the luminous companion counteracts by exposure.

changed_reading.before: They will be sent to a place called the fire.
changed_reading.after: Their outcome is a lasting attachment to a fire that both punishes and exposes what their covering sought to hide.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coupling of a word with becoming established against a party.
baseline_models.mechanism: Interlocutory speech and competing claims are resolved when one claim is proved and made effective against the truth-covering side.

activation_trace.role: Speech connecting interlocutors supplies a contestable verbal arena.
Rival assertions of right supply the latent dispute behind a ruling against one side.
Establishing and manifesting the true claim supplies closure to that dispute.

changed_reading.before: The sentence reports a settled decree without showing a contest.
changed_reading.after: The word functions as an adjudicated claim whose truth has been established against the party that covered it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Protective covering of sin and repeated invitations to return frame the condemned covering as a persisted response to an open call, not as an identity sealed before response.

activation_trace.role: Truth-concealment remains the focus behavior whose persistence is being specified.
Protective covering of sin supplies an available counter-process to punitive attachment.
Repeated petitions for sin-covering keep that counter-process active immediately after the focus.
A verbal summons toward faith supplies the decision point at which the response occurs.
Repeated covering when summoned turns the focus label into an enacted refusal.

structural_cues: 40:3 pairs forgiving sin with accepting return before severe requital.
40:7 asks protection for those who turn and follow the way.
40:10 gives the temporal sequence: they were called to faith and then covered.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an open return, protective forgiveness, and call-then-cover sequence; I infer that persistence under invitation makes the word due. A live alternative is that these passages contrast fixed groups without defining how membership changes.

changed_reading.before: The due word sounds like an unconditional fate attached to a static group name.
changed_reading.after: The due word attaches to maintained truth-covering after an available call and return, while forgiveness remains the opposed covering operation.

context_deltas.mechanism: A tightly wound dispute uses unstable falsehood to make truth lose its footing; the following established word reverses that attempted displacement and fixes judgment upon the disputants.

activation_trace.role: Manifest establishment supplies the focus counter-move that settles the contest.
An entwined adversarial dispute supplies the speech struggle immediately before the focus.
Loss of truth and stability supplies the defective instrument used in that struggle.
A slipping foot supplies the attempted mechanism for making truth lose its stance.
Truth's stable correspondence supplies what the disputants try and fail to dislodge.

structural_cues: 40:5 orders dispute, falsehood, attempted dislodgment of truth, divine seizure, and requital.
40:6 begins with an analogical connective and changes the same root from the object called truth to a verb of becoming due.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attempted displacement followed by seizure and an analogical conclusion; I supply the recoil arrow by which failed displacement becomes a word fixed against its agents. The alternative is a looser historical analogy with no direct causal recoil.

changed_reading.before: The word becomes due as an isolated divine decree.
changed_reading.after: The word is the successful counter-act in a speech struggle: falsehood fails to unseat truth, and the established claim instead settles upon its challengers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The coverers are brought into open view, hidden contents are known, and a decisive judgment proceeds by truth; the fire's revealing aspect thus becomes evidentiary rather than merely decorative.

activation_trace.role: Material covering supplies the condition that the later exposure reverses.
Illumination supplies a possible revealing function for the fire relation.
Open emergence supplies the public reversal of concealment.
Hidden contents in the breasts specify what is penetrated by divine knowledge.
A cutting judgment supplies the formal act that follows exposure.
Stable truth supplies the criterion of that judgment.

structural_cues: 40:16 says all are exposed and nothing of them is hidden.
40:17 ties recompense to what each soul earned and excludes injustice.
40:19-20 move from hidden breasts to judgment by truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, exposure, known interiors, earned recompense, and truthful judgment; I infer that fire-light participates in disclosure. The live alternative is that fire remains only punitive while exposure occurs independently.

changed_reading.before: Fire is only the penalty named by the verdict.
changed_reading.after: Fire belongs to a public judgment process that exposes the covering, makes hidden commitments visible, and applies the due word by truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet contrasts a believer's protective concealment under lethal power with rejection despite manifest evidence, followed by stamped hearts and a blocked way; concealment is morally specified by what it hides and what it suppresses.

activation_trace.role: Suppression of truth supplies the condemned kind of covering that requires differentiation.
Protective hiding of faith supplies a materially similar but morally opposed concealment.
Manifest evidence supplies the truth that hostile covering refuses to receive.
A stamped seal supplies the closure produced around arrogant disputation.
Turning away and obstruction supply the resulting directional loss.

structural_cues: 40:28 explicitly calls the concealer a believer and places his concealment under a threat to kill.
The same speaker appeals to manifest proofs, while 40:35 returns to unsupported dispute.
40:35-37 sequence arrogant dispute, heart-stamping, decorated action, and obstruction from the way.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two concealment situations with opposite objects and a later closure sequence; I infer that the focus condemns suppressing manifest truth, not hiddenness as such. The alternative is that the two roots are independent and no contrast is intended.

changed_reading.before: The covering image risks making every act of concealment sound equivalent.
changed_reading.after: The due word targets concealment that suppresses manifest truth and hardens into obstruction, while protective concealment of endangered faith remains categorically different.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reciprocal calls create opposed directions and affiliations: the believer calls toward extraction and rescue, while his people call him to cover and associate, which is explicitly rendered as calling him to fire and culminates in the repeated companions-of-fire formula.

activation_trace.role: Sustained accompaniment supplies the social and durative core of the focus designation.
Opposed verbal summonses supply the social mechanism that directs affiliation.
Rescue by separation supplies the destination opposed to attachment to fire.
The explicit fire destination identifies what one party's call recruits toward.
The invited act of covering truth gives the fire-directed call its operative content.
The repeated companionship formula confirms durable affiliation as the result of those calls.
The repeated fire term closes the call-to-affiliation sequence on the focus destination.

structural_cues: 40:41 is balanced as 'I call you to rescue / you call me to fire.'
40:42 expands the fire-call as an invitation to cover God and associate without knowledge.
40:43 repeats the focus predicate with the excessive in place of those who covered.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal calls, opposed destinations, and exact predicate repetition; I infer that calling is a recruitment process that forms companionship. The alternative is that the calls merely describe beliefs while companionship remains only a later legal label.

changed_reading.before: Companions of fire is a static label assigned after judgment.
changed_reading.after: Companionship with fire is socially rehearsed through whom one calls, follows, and recruits; the final affiliation realizes a direction already enacted.

context_deltas.mechanism: A consequence closes around Pharaoh's people and becomes repeated exposure to fire at both ends of the day before final entry, spatializing and temporalizing what it means for the word to have become due upon them.

activation_trace.role: Binding adherence supplies the focus liability that the later scene renders spatially.
Descending harm that surrounds its object supplies an enclosing realization of consequence.
The kindled fire supplies the recurrent object of exposure.
Presentation into view supplies repeated contact rather than a single terminal transfer.
Morning departure supplies one boundary of the recurring exposure cycle.
Evening time supplies the other boundary and closes the daily cycle.

structural_cues: 40:45 moves from the believer's protection to harm enclosing Pharaoh's people.
40:46 distinguishes morning-and-evening exposure from the later command to enter the severest punishment when the Hour rises.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enclosure, recurring exposure, and later entry; I let the nearby but distinct roots for becoming due and closing around color one another spatially. The alternative is that the sound proximity is inert and 40:45-46 only illustrates the verdict.

changed_reading.before: The due word points to one future placement in fire.
changed_reading.after: The due word can be experienced as consequence closing around its subjects through recurrent exposure before its final judicial intensification.

context_deltas.mechanism: Inside fire, followers and the arrogant remain together but resume contention; the hierarchy that organized following cannot provide even a share of relief, and divine judgment replaces its failed protection.

activation_trace.role: Accompaniment supplies the shared condition whose social quality is tested.
Competing argument supplies conflict within, rather than solidarity through, co-presence.
Following behind supplies the prior hierarchy binding the two parties.
Failed sufficiency supplies the collapse of the leaders' promised capacity to shield followers.
Judgment between people supplies the authority that supersedes their hierarchy.

structural_cues: 40:47 locates the argument inside fire and makes followers ask their former superiors for partial relief.
40:48 answers that all are in it and that God has judged between the servants.
40:49-50 continues with an unavailing appeal to the keepers and the recalled arrival of messengers with proofs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies co-presence, prior following, a request for transferred relief, and its failure; I infer that companionship here exposes counterfeit solidarity. The alternative is that 'companions' never carried a social implication and simply denotes occupants.

changed_reading.before: Companions of fire may sound like a homogeneous collective.
changed_reading.after: Their only durable commonality is the fire itself: former relations of following and superiority persist long enough to be exposed as incapable of protection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same stable truth that binds the punitive word also guarantees support for messengers and believers; delayed visibility does not weaken either side, because the promised order culminates in decisive judgment by truth.

activation_trace.role: Aid that makes its recipient prevail supplies the positive side of the reliable order.
A spoken promise opening expectation supplies the temporal form of divine reliability.
Stable correspondence with reality guarantees that the promise is not displaced by delay.
A promise oriented to an appointed horizon supplies certainty while leaving whether the addressee sees it open.
Decisive judgment supplies the eventual execution point of the promised order.
Manifest establishment of truth supplies the criterion by which falsehood finally loses.

structural_cues: 40:51 promises support in present life and on the day witnesses rise.
40:55 and 40:77 repeat that God's promise is true while commanding patience.
40:77 leaves open whether some promised consequence is seen before death; 40:78 closes with the arrival of God's command and judgment by truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies support, repeated true promise, uncertain observational timing, and eventual judgment; I infer that the focus word is one punitive side of the same reliable promise structure. The alternative is that 'word,' 'promise,' and 'command' remain separate formulas.

changed_reading.before: The focus word is an isolated threat whose truth depends on immediate visible fulfillment.
changed_reading.after: It is the adverse side of a two-sided reliable promise: support and requital are equally fixed even when their visible timing differs.

context_deltas.mechanism: A lordly process carries created life through stages until maturity and a fixed term; immediately afterward, decisive speech makes its object occur. These sequences activate the due word as an effect-bearing utterance that ripens to realization.

activation_trace.role: Gradual cultivation and completion supply the focus speaker's processive lordship.
A creature reaching its completed condition supplies a material image for the word's ripening.
Meaningful utterance supplies the verbal entity whose effect unfolds.
Reaching a goal supplies the stage transition into maturity and appointed completion.
A fixed temporal limit supplies the horizon at which the process completes.
A cutting decision supplies the initiating determination.
Voiced saying supplies the performative medium of that determination.
Occurrence in time supplies the immediate realized effect of the saying.

structural_cues: 40:67 orders human formation through material stages, childhood, strength, old age, and a named term.
40:68 places deciding an affair, saying to it, and its occurring in one compact sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies staged completion and decision-saying-occurrence; I map the lifecycle's maturation onto the word's becoming due and treat saying as causally effective. The alternative is that the two sequences describe distinct powers without explaining the focus wording.

changed_reading.before: The word is information about an already fixed result.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the Lord's word is performative seed and process: its determined effect advances through its term until it reaches completed actuality.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across prior peoples, manifest proofs are met by self-satisfied knowledge and mockery until the mocked consequence surrounds them; recognition after sight no longer benefits, and the sequence is named a traversed divine way.

activation_trace.role: Binding necessity supplies the focus consequence whose recurrence is traced.
Manifest evidence supplies the repeatedly available disclosure preceding refusal.
Harm descending and surrounding supplies the historical realization of what was mocked.
The absence of benefit marks the point at which late recognition no longer reverses the established result.
A traversed, followed way supplies the repeatable structure behind the focus analogy.
Past generations passing away supplies the historical depth of that recurring way.
The closing recurrence of truth-coverers identifies the class upon whom loss repeatedly settles.

structural_cues: 40:82 explicitly asks for travel and inspection of the outcome of earlier, stronger peoples.
40:83-84 sequence proofs, delight in possessed knowledge, surrounding consequence, sight, and late belief.
40:85 calls the pattern God's way already passed among His servants and closes with the loss of the coverers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated historical outcomes and explicitly names a passed divine way; I take the focus's analogical opening as indexing that recurrence. The alternative is that the final way summarizes only late faith's uselessness, not every element of the focus verdict.

changed_reading.before: Thus introduces one comparison with the immediately preceding people.
changed_reading.after: Thus points into a recurrent historical law: proof is covered, consequence closes around the coverers, late sight cannot undo it, and the established word is the stable form of that repeated path.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines non-dominant bodily branches of two focus roots and adds a directional arrow from utterance to penetration. It remains anchored in the focus word and becoming-due verb, with the later exposure sequence supplying support. Render only as a lexical-material echo, never as the lexical definition or an exclusive interpretation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins the Lord's word, becoming established, covering, and fire.

activation_trace.role: A bodily wound supplies a material underside to the otherwise verbal word.
A straight thrust penetrating inward supplies the word's imagined mode of taking effect.
A covering layer supplies what the penetrating word passes through.
Open exposure supplies the resulting state after the imagined penetration of covering.

changed_reading.before: The word is solely semantic content announcing a verdict.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material metaphor, the word is also a penetrating wound: it passes through the cover and leaves its object exposed to the fire.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets a near-consonantal cross-root echo between companionship and dragging activate the reading, and it also uses a branch of the kindling root that concerns mixing in company. The explicit chains, dragging, fire, and permanence keep it anchored. Render as sound-and-material resonance, not as etymology between distinct roots.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The designation companions of fire links durable accompaniment to the fire medium.

activation_trace.role: Durable accompaniment supplies the focus relation to be materially reimagined.
Dragging and extending supplies coerced motion into the relation rather than voluntary company.
The explicit fire supplies the destination and medium into which the chained group is drawn.
Ignition and agitation supply the fire's active treatment of those dragged into it.
Mixing through companionship supplies a branch-distant resonance of occupants forced into one medium.

changed_reading.before: Companions are simply occupants already located in fire.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, companionship becomes forced transport and mixing: chains drag the group into a kindled medium that is their only remaining common bond.

strongest_changes: The due word became the recoil and settlement of an attempted falsehood-driven displacement of truth.
Forgiveness and repeated invitation bounded the verdict around persistent covering rather than a response-independent identity.
Reciprocal calls made companionship with fire an affiliation socially enacted before it became a final condition.
Exposure, failed hierarchy, true promise, performative completion, and the closing historical way turned the compact verdict into an evidentiary and recurrent process.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly converted abstract predicates in 40:6 into mechanisms: covering met exposure, disputed truth became decisive judgment, companionship became recruited and then coercive co-presence, and a due word became both a maturing performance and a traversed historical law.
remaining_uncertainties: The identification of the focus word with the later promise, command, and performative saying is strongly suggestive but not lexically explicit.
The spatial coloring from ح ي ق and the dragging resonance from س ح ب are cross-root activations, not etymological claims.
Companionship may primarily denote duration, class membership, social co-presence, or all three; the packet keeps those functions live.
